title: 07 · Two keys, one room
objective: Tell modifying an Object apart from reassigning a reference variable.
instructions: Box has one field, value. Write rename(Box box, String text) to change the Box's value.
Do not create a new Box; modify the Object the caller is holding.
hints: Modify the field of the object you received, not the local variable box.
box.value and box = new Box(...) have different effects.
